newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL RAISES PETROL, DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL RAISES PETROL, DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Tuesday it was raising its pump prices for petrol in the Netherlands by two cents per litre and diesel by two cents/litre effective Thursday.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, the firm said.
From Thursday the price of premium unleaded petrol at Shell's self-service stations rises to 2.08 guilders per litre from the current 2.06 guilders.
The price of premium with lead substitute will rise to 2.14 guilders and that of Euro regular unleaded to 2.03 guilders.
The recommended price for diesel will be raised to 1.50 guilders per litre, Shell said. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
